whoami.description: Signed-in user's email, read from the dashboard profile page. Returns {stop:"sudo"|"turnstile"|"no-email-found"} instead of clicking through a blocking page.

returns.description: email address, or {stop} on a blocking page

api.description: Cookie-authenticated fetch("/api/v4"+path) on the logged-in dash.cloudflare.com tab, acting as the signed-in user (no token, no CSRF header needed; GET/POST/PATCH verified 2026-09-04). Use for anything a scoped user token cannot reach: reading /user/tokens/permission_groups, writing a zone setting outside the token's policy.

returns.description: parsed JSON response body, or {stop} on a blocking page

mintToken.description: Mint a user API token via the dashboard session. Built on api(). The minted value is returned to the caller only, never logged by this tool.

policies.description: Cloudflare token policy objects: [{effect, resources, permission_groups}]

setZoneSetting.description: PATCH one zone setting via the dashboard session. Built on api().
